posts.community: Aimtron Electronics Ltd (EMS China+1 Global Play)
posts.text: FY26 numbers are genuinely impressive , revenue grew nearly 90% to ₹301 crore and PAT grew around 79% to ₹46 crore, with EBITDA margins of about 22%. The problem is valuation and cash flow. At the current valuation ,78x trailing earnings and about 15x book value, I think the market is already pricing in several years of 40–50% growth with very little room for execution mistakes.
